goal: Require a current, scoped skill and security review before implementing each new Nilaza feature.
successCriteria: A new feature record fails preflight when required plan, source, skill, scope, or security evidence is missing.
Database-write intent fails while the recorded Supabase migration ledger is blocked.
A pull request changing feature code, design, or documentation must include a reviewed record covering its changed files.
Allowlisted local feature commands rerun preflight and check their outputs and dirty execution inputs before starting.
untouchedSurfaces: The mobile, Admin, and website runtime interfaces and user data remain unchanged.
Supabase schema, Edge Functions, deployment state, and provider credentials remain unchanged.

impact.entryPoint: Agents start a feature through the routed plan, preflight, and allowlisted feature:run commands.
impact.dataWrite: The validator reads repository evidence only; this task publishes governance, reviewed skills, and their local QC scripts.
impact.backendContract: No running API contract changes; the migration ledger remains a gate for database writes.
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin runtime screen changes; the manager receives a readable preflight result and handoff.
impact.privacySafety: Records use sanitized project context and reject forbidden data classes and likely credential strings.
impact.observability: Local and CI commands report pass or fail without collecting private telemetry.
impact.rollback: Revert the scoped governance files and reinstall the prior reviewed skill version if this gate misroutes work.

canonicalContracts: packages/agent-config/agent-execution-policy.json governs allowed agent data classes and authority.
supabase/migration-ledger.json governs whether a planned database write may proceed.

sourceReview.reason: Reviewed current product guardrails and agent entry instructions.
Reviewed current task lanes and required validation routes.
Reviewed the required impact and QC gate before editing.
Reviewed agent authority and safe delegation boundaries.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Added source freshness, affected-skill disposition, security stop conditions, and preflight command guidance.

skillReview.name: nilaza-tarot-deck-production
skillReview.evidence: Published the reviewed deck-production skill and its focused QC scripts in the repository manifest and routing.

skillReview.name: nilaza-tarot-content-qc
skillReview.evidence: Published the reviewed bilingual Tarot content QC skill in the repository manifest and routing.

skillReview.name: nilaza-tarot-art-qc
skillReview.evidence: Published the reviewed Tarot artwork QC skill in the repository manifest and routing.

dependencyReview.evidence: This governance change adds no package or external API behavior and uses current repository sources.

securityReview.authzRls: No authentication or RLS code changes; the record requires a scoped review for later feature tasks.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Only sanitized project context is allowed; no user birth, journal, chat, or face data is needed.
securityReview.secretsLogging: Likely credential strings in plans are rejected without echoing their values; no credentials are requested.
securityReview.externalInput: Record and source paths are constrained to repository files; plan commands are never executed.
securityReview.dependencies: No dependency install is required; official source evidence becomes mandatory for volatile claims.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Database-write intent stops while the migration ledger is blocked; deployments remain separately authorized.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop when skill drift, source hashes, write scope, or unresolved high-risk review fails.

workingTreeReview.note: Skill sources and scoped QC changes were reviewed; unrelated app, Supabase, and QA worktree changes remain outside this record.

validationCommands: Use the configured bundled Python runtime to AST-parse the scoped Tarot QC scripts without writing bytecode.
managerTestPath: Ask Codex to run the scoped preflight record, then verify an unsupported or unscoped feature:run command is blocked.
residualRisk: Direct shell commands bypass the runner; dynamic or ignored dependencies need human review, while PR CI checks committed scope rather than local command order.
